name: @lacspace/sequence
description: Multi-step follow-up email sequences as a pure state machine: no I/O, no timers, no storage. Given a sequence, a plain-JSON enrollment and `now`, nextAction() says send / wait (with the exact next time) / skip / stop / paused. Delays in days, hours, minutes and business days; send windows (days of week, HH:MM or fractional hours, holidays) in the recipient's IANA timezone, DST-correct via Intl (Asia/Kathmandu +05:45 included); stop on reply, bounce, unsubscribe, complaint, click, meeting booked or manual stop; step conditions (no_reply, opened, no_open, clicked, no_click); pause/resume; 3-strike failure stop with retry delay; reply threading; seeded deterministic jitter; due() scheduler tick with per-hour and per-day send budgets; previewTimeline() and validateSequence(). Zero dependencies, isomorphic.
author: Lacspace <contact@lacspace.com>
